pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Heterogeneous dark brown polygonal regions exhibiting high-frequency jagged edges and sharp pixel gradients. Spatial area of patches is smaller and more compressed along the dorsal ridge, transitioning to larger, more elongated geometries on the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous light-colored negative space forming a complex topological graph. Intersections consist primarily of 3-way and 4-way junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively consistent across the mid-flank but exhibits narrowing at acute-angle patch vertices.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the visible upper neck displays a 1D geometric contour consisting of short, upright hairs producing a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette against the background.
